subject: Azure Marketplace offer manifest & co-sell readiness — Acme Cloud
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecloud.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: New Azure offer submission — initial manifest + validation asks

Hi Hannah / team,

Thanks for the onboarding call this morning. Attached is our initial manifest (acme-manifest-v1.json) and a couple of screenshots from our staging UI. We're ready to start the Azure technical validation but want to confirm a few items before we kick off:

- Do you need a publisher sandbox tenant from Microsoft or can you validate against our existing staging subscription?
- We have multiple SKUs (Starter, Pro, Enterprise) — is SKU to plan mapping required in the manifest or handled in the portal?
- Any immediate blockers from a co-sell perspective (MSA, co-sell paperwork) that would prevent us from moving to test-publish?

Attached: acme-manifest-v1.json, offer-screenshot-validate.png

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Doe
Head of Product, Acme Cloud Solutions
jane.doe@acmecloud.com
+1 415-555-0142

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New Azure offer submission — initial manifest + validation asks

Hi Jane — great to see the manifest. Quick responses and proposed timeline below.

1) Publisher sandbox tenant: we'll request a Microsoft test tenant for the full validation (required for co-sell certification). If you prefer we can start lightweight checks against your staging subscription in parallel — please share an ephemeral read-only service principal.

2) SKU mapping: include planId for each SKU in the manifest. The portal accepts SKU definitions but the manifest must contain stable plan IDs for co-sell metadata. I'll attach a short checklist (see related_links) for required manifest keys.

3) Co-sell paperwork: nothing blocking today — procurement and legal items typically get wrapped up during the co-sell enablement step. If you have an existing MSA with Microsoft, please share the reference ID; otherwise we'll route to our marketplace support contact.

Proposed timeline (target):
- 48h: basic manifest sanity (we'll run a quick lint)
- 3 business days: technical validation with MS sandbox tenant (once tenant & SP are available)
- 7 business days: co-sell enablement prep & MAP (mutual action plan)

Next steps: Jane, can you provision a read-only SP and confirm whether Acme wants us to request the MS test tenant on your behalf? If you prefer we can open the marketplace support case (I'll include the support email).

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Marketplace Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New Azure offer submission — initial manifest + validation asks

On Tue, May 13, 2025 at 10:02 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> 1) Publisher sandbox tenant: we'll request a Microsoft test tenant for the full validation (required for co-sell certification).

Quick tech notes from my side after a quick lint of acme-manifest-v1.json:

- Missing planId on the "Pro" SKU (portal will complain). Add stable planId strings and ensure they match SKU names exactly.
- Offer shipping model: is this SaaS or VM-based? The manifest doesn't set "kind" explicitly. If SaaS, include the SaaS webhook endpoints + auth expectations. If VM, we need VM image metadata.
- SP & permissions: for stage validation provide a service principal with the following Reader + Website Contributor rights (or an ephemeral SAS if you prefer).
- Container images: if you're using containerized service hooks, please confirm image registry (ACR vs DockerHub) and share a test image tag.

I'll attach a short sample manifest snippet to illustrate the required planId and kind fields; also adding a quick checklist of the portal test cases I run (offer publish, plan purchase flow, SaaS webhook handshake).

Attachment stubs: sample-manifest-snippet.json, sku-plan-checklist.txt

I'll queue the full validation once we have the SP + confirmation on SaaS vs VM.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Engineer, Platform Integrations, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New Azure offer submission — initial manifest + validation asks

Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks — quick procurement note: Acme can provide a PO (PO-ACME-2025-338) for the first three months of the co-sell pilot. We also need confirmation of the pricing SOW for marketplace billable items and whether Redwood will accept the MS co-sell customer referral terms.

Also looping in legal later this week for a quick redline if needed. Any documentation you can share on co-sell terms/commissions will help speed the review.

Regards,
Acme Procurement
procurement@acmecloud.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecloud.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Azure Marketplace Support <marketplace-support@microsoft.com>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New Azure offer submission — initial manifest + validation asks

Hi Jane / procurement team — appreciate the PO and the quick turnaround. Next steps from Redwood sales/partner side: 

- I'll prepare a short co-sell one-pager that maps Acme SKUs to MS co-sell eligibility and include suggested go-to-market motions.
- I'll open a HubSpot deal (see related_links) and attach a mutual action plan; please review the MAP and add owners/timelines.
- I'll start the DocuSign envelope for the co-sell acknowledgement and attach the marketplace participation terms for signature.

For technical: Karthik will kickoff the manifest fixes as soon as we get the SP + confirmation of SaaS vs VM. Hannah — please open the MS support case to request the publisher sandbox tenant; include the PO reference so MS can prioritize the validation window.

We've attached a draft mutual-action-plan (mutual-action-plan.xlsx) for your review. I'm also adding marketplace-support@microsoft.com to ensure they see the tenant request.

Proposed milestone dates (subject to your sign-off):
- 20 May: manifest finalization + SP provisioned
- 22 May: MS sandbox assigned and validation begun
- 29 May: co-sell enablement readiness call

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
